issue.title: Going offline Audit
issue.body:
Audit the Going offline against related GitHub issues and expected behavior. Test the latest supported mobile build, document results, and create `dev ready` issues for any identified gaps.

**Done when:** The assessment is merged, all gaps are linked to actionable issues, and the audit result is posted to this sub-ticket.

comments.body:
## Going offline audit — result

**Overall:** Pass with gaps

**Assessment PR:** https://github.com/eten-tech-foundation/fluent-mobile/pull/577

**Assessment (on the branch until merge):** `docs/assessments/going-offline/README.md`

**Build / env:** nightly `1.0.0` (release build of `main` @ `d5b9e64`; C.14 and G.31 on a local debug build of the same commit) against `dev.api.fluent.bible`
**Device:** Xiaomi Redmi Note 9 Pro, Android 10 (API 29), physical device

**Summary:** The Prepare for Offline mechanics work: the Settings entry, assigned chapter selection, Customize download, Pause / Resume / Cancel, resume after connection loss or an app kill, storage management, and the cellular toggle mirror. The offline session also works: offline cold start, the gray header state, Home, My Work, Projects, the Sync page, account switching, and local stage advancement. The main risk is that **preparing for offline does not make content usable offline**. Downloads are still mock fixtures (Gap 5), and even the downloaded files are never read: Resources (Gap 1) and source audio (Gap 2) always call the API. Gaps 1–2 should be decided on as launch blockers.

**Gaps:**

| Gap | Finding | Severity | Launch blocker | Issue |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Resources (TN / TQ / Images) are not shown offline after Prepare for Offline | High | To be decided with product | #578 |
| 2 | Source audio does not play offline after Prepare for Offline | High | To be decided with product | #579 |
| 3 | Unassigned project: the chapter accordion is collapsed and Download is enabled with no chapter selected | Medium | No | #580 |
| 4 | The Prepare for Offline auto-prompt fires inconsistently (#39) | Medium | No | #581 |
| 5 | Downloads are mock fixtures, and a newly selected chapter shows "Download complete" | Medium | No | added to #504 (fix in progress: PR #562) |
| 6 | Download "starts" on cellular (toggle off) or offline with no feedback | Medium | No | added to #546 and PR #559 (fix in progress) |
| 7 | After an offline "Send to Peer Check", the chapter leaves My Work with no pending-sync state | Low | No | added to #257 (not started) |

**Pending:** E.19 (in-flight download pause when Wi-Fi drops) and the other transport scenarios (A.1–A.3, E.17–E.18, F.20, G.22, G.28, G.31) are re-tested after PR #559 merges.

Will update this comment with the merged assessment link after #577 merges.

## Going offline audit — tests executed

These are the tests run to reach the results and gaps in this audit.

All tests were run on a physical Android device with access to Wi-Fi and mobile data.

### A. Auto-prompt

- **A.1** Opened the app on Home with Wi-Fi on, for a project with no connectivity profile or a `Rarely Connected` profile (also re-run in isolation with a single-project account after clearing app data). Expected: Prepare for Offline opens automatically.
- **A.2** Dismissed Prepare for Offline without downloading, then reopened the app on Wi-Fi. Expected: the screen opens automatically again.
- **A.3** Opened the app on mobile data only, with "Upload/Download over cellular" off. Expected: Prepare for Offline does not open automatically.
- **A.4** Reopened the app on Wi-Fi after a download had started. Expected: Prepare for Offline does not open automatically.
- **A.5** Opened Settings → Prepare for Offline. Expected: the screen opens regardless of the auto-prompt state.

### B. Chapter selection

- **B.6** Opened Prepare for Offline as a translator with assigned chapters. Expected: the chapter accordion is collapsed, labeled "Assigned chapters (n)", with the assigned chapters pre-selected.
- **B.7** Opened Prepare for Offline for a project with no chapters assigned to the user. Expected: the accordion is open, no chapter is selected, and Download stays disabled until a chapter is selected.
- **B.8** Used a book's "Select all" and the chapter grid. Expected: all chapters of the book toggle together; the grid has 5 columns; the selected count updates live.

### C. Download

- **C.9** Reviewed the "Resources to download" section. Expected: resources grouped by name with Text / Audio sizes, Tier 1 locked, with real resource names and sizes.
- **C.10** Opened Customize download and deselected a Tier 2/3 item. Expected: the total and the Download button label update, and the item is not downloaded.
- **C.11** Tapped Download, then Pause, then Resume, and let the download finish. Expected: the controls swap, progress is kept, and each progress ring turns into a green check.
- **C.12** Started a new download and tapped Cancel. Expected: the download stops at once with no dialog, and the Download button returns.
- **C.13** After a completed download, selected another chapter. Expected: the size updates and the Download button is available.
- **C.14** Inspected the downloaded files on the device after a completed online download. Expected: real content for the project, not test fixture files.

### D. Storage

- **D.15** Opened Manage Device Storage. Expected: available space and Fluent usage are shown, other projects are listed, and an empty state appears when there are none.
- **D.16** Selected another project's resources and tapped Delete Selected. Expected: the freed-space counter updates live, the "Delete selected resources?" dialog appears, and the items are removed after confirming.

### E. Transport

- **E.17** Toggled "Upload/Download over cellular" in Settings. Expected: the toggle on the Sync page mirrors it.
- **E.18** On mobile data only, with the toggle off, tapped Download. Expected: the download does not start, and the screen explains why.
- **E.19** While downloading on Wi-Fi, turned Wi-Fi off with mobile data on and the toggle off. Expected: the download pauses.

### F. Interruptions

- **F.20** While downloading, turned on airplane mode for 30 seconds, then brought Wi-Fi back. Expected: the download stops, then resumes on Wi-Fi keeping partial progress.
- **F.21** While downloading, killed the app from Recents and relaunched it on Wi-Fi. Expected: the download resumes or offers Resume, with no stuck progress.

### G. Working offline

- **G.22** Turned on airplane mode. Expected: the header cloud turns gray, showing `cloud-check` when nothing is pending and the pending variant otherwise.
- **G.23** In airplane mode, killed the app and cold-started it. Expected: the user is still signed in, and Home and My Work load.
- **G.24** Offline, opened the Projects tab. Expected: the projects are listed.
- **G.25** Offline, opened the Bible tab of a chapter prepared for offline. Expected: the source text shows and the downloaded source audio plays.
- **G.26** Offline, opened the Resources tab of a chapter prepared for offline. Expected: Translation Notes, Translation Questions and Images & Maps show the downloaded content with no network.
- **G.27** Offline, opened the Resources tab of a chapter that was not prepared. Expected: the sections are shown as unavailable, with no endless loader.
- **G.28** Offline, opened the Sync page. Expected: offline copy is shown, and Sync Now is disabled with a reason.
- **G.29** Offline, switched to another account. Expected: the switch succeeds and that account's local data loads.
- **G.30** Offline, on a chapter with every verse recorded, tapped "Send to Peer Check" on the last verse and confirmed. Expected: the button appears only on the last verse once every verse is recorded, and the stage updates locally at once.
- **G.31** Offline, opened Prepare for Offline and tapped Download. Expected: a clear offline message, with no crash.

## Going offline audit complete — assessment merged

**Merged assessment:** https://github.com/eten-tech-foundation/fluent-mobile/blob/main/docs/assessments/going-offline/README.md
**Assessment PR:** #577 (merged)
**Result:** Pass with gaps

| Gap | Finding | Severity | Launch blocker | Issue |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Downloaded resources are not shown offline in the Resources tab | High | To be decided with product | #578 |
| 2 | Source audio does not play offline after Prepare for Offline | High | To be decided with product | #579 |
| 3 | Unassigned project: the chapter accordion is collapsed and Download is enabled | Medium | No | #580 |
| 4 | The Prepare for Offline auto-prompt fires inconsistently | Medium | No | #581 |
| 5 | Downloads are mock fixtures, and a newly selected chapter shows "Download complete" | Medium | No | #504 (comment; PR #562 open) |
| 6 | Download "starts" with a blocked transport and gives no feedback | Medium | No | #546 (comment; PR #559 open) |
| 7 | After an offline "Send to Peer Check", the chapter leaves My Work with no pending state | Low | No | #257 (comment); see also #530 Gap 8 (High) |

**Still pending:** E.19 and the transport scenarios (A.1–A.3, E.17–E.18, F.20, G.22, G.28, G.31) are re-tested after PR #559 merges (open, changes requested).

**Correction to G.22:** the offline header draws `CloudOff`, not gray `cloud-check` (`src/components/ui/CloudSyncStatusIcon.tsx:297-303`); this audit most likely read the Sync page glyph. The returning online and synchronizing changes audit (#530, A.2) has the correct result, tracked in #603.

## Additional finding after the audit

Found in a re-test on 2026-09-30:

- **Downloads keep running over mobile data when Wi-Fi drops, even with "Upload/Download over cellular" off.** The download in progress fails and the next ones start over mobile data. → #619

@Roslin22

## Going offline — retest

> **Note:** this test script was generated with the help of AI, from the tests executed in the #529 audit (epic #526) and from other information gathered while the issues were implemented. It is a guide, not a limit: any other test that covers these points or goes beyond them is also valid.

> **Linked issues:** when a test ends with an issue number in parentheses, for example `(#581)` at the end of A.1, that is the sub-issue that fixed that point, so you can open it to see what was changed. Some of these issues are still open or depend on work that is not finished yet (for example, fluent-api changes). Those tests are marked with "issue still open" or "may fail". For them, a failure may be expected for now: report what you see, but it does not necessarily mean the fix regressed.

"Prepare for Offline" is the screen where the user picks chapters and downloads content to use without internet (also in Settings → Prepare for Offline). "Cellular option" is "Upload/Download over cellular" in Settings.

**What to prepare:** a phone with a mobile data SIM; an account with assigned chapters and a project where it has **no** assigned chapters; a project with the "Rarely Connected" profile; a single-project account (for A.1); a chapter with source audio, notes, questions and images; another account on the same phone.

### A. Prepare for Offline opening on its own

Repeat each of tests A.1–A.4 **three times in a row**: the result must be the same all three times.

- [ ] **A.1** With Wi-Fi on, open the app with an account whose project is marked "Rarely Connected" (or has no such profile). Repeat after clearing the app data, with a single-project account. Expected: the Prepare for Offline screen opens on its own. (#581)
- [ ] **A.2** Close Prepare for Offline without downloading, close the app and open it again on Wi-Fi. Expected: the screen opens on its own again. (#581)
- [ ] **A.3** Turn Wi-Fi off, leave only mobile data, with the cellular option off, and open the app. Expected: Prepare for Offline does **not** open on its own. (#581)
- [ ] **A.4** After a download has already started, close and open the app on Wi-Fi. Expected: the screen does **not** open on its own. (#581)
- [ ] **A.5** Go to Settings → Prepare for Offline. Expected: the screen always opens.
- [ ] **A.6** When the screen opens on its own (A.1), note whether it opens straight on the project or on the project list. Expected: observation only. (#581)

### B. Choosing chapters

- [ ] **B.6** Open Prepare for Offline with an account that has assigned chapters. Expected: the "Assigned chapters (n)" list is closed, with the assigned chapters already checked.
- [ ] **B.7** Open Prepare for Offline in a project where the user has no assigned chapters. Expected: the chapter list is already open, no chapter is checked, and the Download button stays disabled until a chapter is checked. (#580)
- [ ] **B.7b** In the same project, check a chapter, tap Download, then Cancel. Leave, enter the project again and do not check anything. Expected: the Download button stays disabled with no chapter checked. (#580)
- [ ] **B.8** Use a book's "Select all" and tap chapters in the grid. Expected: "Select all" checks/unchecks every chapter of the book; the grid has 5 columns; the selected count changes at once.

### C. Download

- [ ] **C.9** Look at the "Resources to download" section. Expected: resources are listed by name, with Text and Audio sizes; Tier 1 items cannot be unchecked; names and sizes look real (not test values). (#504 — issue still open)
- [ ] **C.10** Open "Customize download" and uncheck a Tier 2 or 3 item. Expected: the total and the Download button text change, and the unchecked item is not downloaded.
- [ ] **C.11** Tap Download, then Pause, then Resume, and wait for it to finish. Expected: the buttons change with the state, progress does not go back to zero, and each progress circle becomes a green check.
- [ ] **C.12** Start another download and tap Cancel. Expected: the download stops at once, with no confirmation window, and the Download button comes back.
- [ ] **C.13** After a complete download, check a new chapter. Expected: the size updates and the Download button is available ("Download complete" is not shown for a chapter not yet downloaded). (#504 — issue still open)
- [ ] **C.14** After downloading a chapter, turn on airplane mode and open that chapter. Expected: the source audio and resources shown are the real project's content, not sample content. (#504 — issue still open)

### D. Storage

- [ ] **D.15** Open "Manage Device Storage". Expected: the phone's free space and how much Fluent uses are shown; other projects are listed; if there are none, an empty-list message is shown.
- [ ] **D.16** Check another project's resources and tap "Delete Selected". Expected: the freed-space counter changes at once, the "Delete selected resources?" question appears, and after confirming the items disappear.

### E. Wi-Fi and mobile data

- [ ] **E.17** Turn the cellular option on and off in Settings. Expected: the same option on the Sync page follows the choice.
- [ ] **E.18** With only mobile data and the cellular option off, tap Download. Expected: the download does not start, the screen explains why, and the Pause/Cancel buttons do **not** appear as if it were downloading. (#546)
- [ ] **E.19** During a download on Wi-Fi, turn Wi-Fi off (mobile data on, cellular option off). Expected: the download pauses, does not continue over mobile data, and no item shows as "failed". (#619)
- [ ] **E.19b** Continuing from E.19, turn Wi-Fi back on. Expected: the download continues on its own, from where it stopped. (#619)

### F. Interruptions

- [ ] **F.20** During a download, turn on airplane mode for 30 seconds, then bring Wi-Fi back. Expected: the download stops, then continues on Wi-Fi from where it stopped.
- [ ] **F.21** During a download, close the app from recent apps and open it again on Wi-Fi. Expected: the download continues or offers a Resume button, without getting stuck.

### G. Using the app offline

- [ ] **G.22** Turn on airplane mode. Expected: the cloud icon at the top turns gray: **gray cloud with a check** when nothing is waiting to upload, and **gray crossed-out cloud** when recordings are waiting.
- [ ] **G.23** In airplane mode, close the app from recent apps and open it again. Expected: the user is still signed in, and Home and My Work load.
- [ ] **G.24** Offline, open the Projects tab. Expected: the projects are shown.
- [ ] **G.25** Offline, open the Bible tab of a downloaded chapter. Expected: the text is shown and the source audio plays, also after closing and opening the app. (#579)
- [ ] **G.25b** Offline, open the Bible tab of a chapter that was **not** downloaded. Expected: the player shows "No source audio", not a Retry button. (#579)
- [ ] **G.26** Offline, open the Resources tab of a downloaded chapter. Expected: Translation Notes, Translation Questions and Images & Maps show their content, even without internet. (#578 — issue still open)
- [ ] **G.27** Offline, open the Resources tab of a chapter that was **not** downloaded. Expected: "No resources are on this device yet. Download them from Prepare for Offline." is shown, without loading forever. (#578)
- [ ] **G.28** Offline, open the Sync page. Expected: a message says you are offline, and the Sync Now button is disabled with the reason.
- [ ] **G.29** Offline, switch to another account. Expected: the switch works and that account's data is shown.
- [ ] **G.30** Offline, in a chapter with every verse recorded, go to the last verse, tap "Send to Peer Check" and confirm. Expected: the button appears only on the last verse once every verse is recorded; the chapter's stage changes at once; the chapter stays in My Work showing it still needs to sync. (#257 — issue still open, expected to fail until it is built)
- [ ] **G.31** Offline, open Prepare for Offline and tap Download. Expected: a clear message that you are offline, no Pause/Cancel buttons as if it were downloading, and the app does not close. (#546)
